title: Club Meeting 05/07/2026
summary: The Rotary Club of Mumbai Bravehearts meeting was held on 5 July 2026 at MCA Club, with 18 members in attendance.
description:
The Rotary Club of Mumbai Bravehearts meeting was held on 5 July 2026 at MCA Club, with 18 members in attendance. Key discussions included the status of four Global Grant projects—The Gift of Sound, IRIS, Touching Little Hearts, and RED—with three USD 30,000 applications ready for submission and the fourth requiring additional funding. Around USD 115,000 has been raised across the projects.

Six initiatives were submitted for Whale Tank applications, covering football, accessibility, hearing loss, infant eye care, autism, and mobility. The Club will co-host Football at Impact Games India, encouraging members, family, and friends to register and participate.

Rtn. Nishit Shetty presented the new project onboarding and execution process, covering planning, responsibilities, timelines, partner coordination, implementation, and monitoring. The meeting concluded with member introductions, a call for active project participation, secretarial announcements, and Charter Day cake cutting follow
